arjun (DevEx): Noticed multiple onboarding tickets: SDKs inconsistent about when to retry vs when to surface permission errors. Need a quick sync.
nina (SDK): which behaviors are mismatched?
arjun (DevEx): node sampleapp returns opaque error objects; go returns typed errors but missing http_status in logs. Customers get stuck deciding whether to refresh tokens.
paul (PM): high level: 401 -> try refresh, 403 -> no retry, 429 -> respect Retry-After. But we also have weird 403 bodies that indicate expired tokens.
han (eng): we should canonicalize at the API edge: map auth responses to a normalized envelope we can guarantee across clients.
arjun (DevEx): proposal for user-facing envelope: {"error_type":"string","code":"string","message":"string","http_status":"int","retry_policy":"string","hint":"string","retry_after":"string?"} Keep messages short and actionable. Put stack/traces in telemetry only.
nina (SDK): in SDKs we'll expose typed error classes with methods: isRetryable(), statusCode(), code(). For go we'll have error interfaces. For node we'll add properties on the Error subclass.
paul (PM): include a `hint` that suggests clear next action like "refresh token" or "contact support with trace id XYZ". That will cut support loops.
han (eng): for retry_policy let's use enum values: none, idempotent_only, safe, always. We'll compute this server-side based on endpoint and status.
ci-bot: CI alert: sampleapp-tests failing on legacy error shape; see run 4521.
arjun (DevEx): migration approach: SDKs add new typed surface and shims to return legacy shape when env var REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS=1. Sampleapps updated to emit new envelope by default.
nina (SDK): tests: map 401 -> if auth response includes "refreshable":true then retry_policy=always, else none. 403 -> none. 429 -> idempotent_only + retry_after from header. 5xx -> idempotent_only by default.
paul (PM): telemetry: emit tag error_ux:v3 and include normalized_http_status for internal analytics. Also attach migration_cohort.
han (eng): edge-case: auth server returns 500 with body that includes "token_expired". We'll add a rule in auth-proxy to normalize to 401/refreshable.
arjun (DevEx): action items: @nina implement SDK classes and legacy shim, @han add normalization rules and envelope at the edge, @paul update onboarding docs and FAQ. I'll draft the spec doc and sample snippets.
paul (PM): timeline: spec this week, SDK patches next week, sampleapps + proxy rules the week after, docs update before next cohort.
ci-bot: scheduled rollout: 2026-03-30 03:00 UTC
arjun (DevEx): quick sign-off? nina/han/paul
nina (SDK): :thumbsup:
han (eng): :thumbsup:
paul (PM): :thumbsup:
arjun (DevEx): thanks everyone — expect PR links in the spec doc.
